archetypes.name: dyn-scope-gate
archetypes.rationale: Review the narrow todo classifier and Step 2 disposition gate behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the scope disposition change that filters manifest todos before deciding whether a disposition prompt is required. Focus on whether benign full-suite validation reminders are excluded without hiding actionable deferred work, malformed manifest entries, or high-band coverage gaps. Check the helper tests and Step 2 dispatch regression for coverage of the real pause path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
